sql: SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY t.created_at) FROM (SELECT created_at, stage, status, provider, message_id, error_message, latency_ms, payload_summary FROM message_trace_logs WHERE conversation_id = '4d83403e-2e8c-4db9-950b-313b99b6108a' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-24T10:54:00Z' AND '2026-10-24T10:56:00Z') t
